name: Gradient of RBF Field
aliases: Fragment program for reconstructing Gaussian radial basis functions
definition: A fragment program that reconstructs scalar field values from procedurally encoded Radial Basis Functions (RBFs) in a single pass, removing multipass-related parts for readability.
summary: This method computes a scalar field and its spatial gradient analytically in a single fragment shader pass using 3D Gaussian RBFs, enabling accurate normal estimation for isosurface rendering.
